1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. O Lord, you examine me and know me.

2.w: You know when I sit down and when I get up; even from far away you understand my motives.

3.w: You carefully observe me when I travel or when I lie down to rest; you are aware of everything I do.

4.w: Certainly my tongue does not frame a word without you, O Lord, being thoroughly aware of it.

5.w: You squeeze me in from behind and in front; you place your hand on me.

6.w: Your knowledge is beyond my comprehension; it is so far beyond me, I am unable to fathom it.

7.w: Where can I go to escape your Spirit? Where can I flee to escape your presence?

8.w: If I were to ascend to heaven, you would be there. If I were to sprawl out in Sheol, there you would be.

9.w: If I were to fly away on the wings of the dawn and settle down on the other side of the sea,

10.w: even there your hand would guide me, your right hand would grab hold of me.

11.w: If I were to say, “Certainly the darkness will cover me, and the light will turn to night all around me,”

12.w: even the darkness is not too dark for you to see, and the night is as bright as day; darkness and light are the same to you.

13.w: Certainly you made my mind and heart; you wove me together in my mother’s womb.

14.w: I will give you thanks because your deeds are awesome and amazing. You knew me thoroughly;

15.w: my bones were not hidden from you, when I was made in secret and sewed together in the depths of the earth.

16.w: Your eyes saw me when I was inside the womb. All the days ordained for me were recorded in your scroll before one of them came into existence.

17.w: How difficult it is for me to fathom your thoughts about me, O God! How vast is their sum total.

18.w: If I tried to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand. Even if I finished counting them, I would still have to contend with you.

19.w: If only you would kill the wicked, O God! Get away from me, you violent men!

20.w: They rebel against you and act deceitfully; your enemies lie.

21.w: O Lord, do I not hate those who hate you and despise those who oppose you?

22.w: I absolutely hate them; they have become my enemies.

23.w: Examine me, O God, and probe my thoughts. Test me, and know my concerns.

24.w: See if there is any idolatrous way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
